name: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin reached 37% in Q3 FY26, up 400 bps sequentially from 33% and up from 28% a year ago.
items.quote: If you see there is a 400 basis point increase in margins sequentially, just quarter -on-quarter. And from last year's margin of 28%, we have landed up at 37%.

items.statement: Consumer group EBITDA margin reached 43% in Q3 FY26, up from 40% sequentially and 35% a year ago.
items.quote: And even sequentially, if you look at EBITDA is up INR6 crores just in this one business. And margins have gone from 40% to 43% sequentially. Over last year, margins has gone from 35% to 43%.

items.statement: Remarketing business EBITDA margin crossed 30% for the first time in Q3 FY26.
items.quote: Margins for the first time crossed 30% in the remarketing business.

items.statement: OLX EBITDA margin reached 37% in Q3 FY26.
items.quote: OLX margins reached 37% now and PAT is up 37%.

items.statement: Management expects OLX revenue growth rate to increase further in Q4 FY26 (January-March) from the current 18% YoY.
items.quote: So that's why I've given a guidance earlier on the call saying that the growth rate of OLX will go up automatically, in this quarter of January to March, and that's the guidance we'd given.

items.statement: Management expects remarketing business growth rates and absolute numbers to improve in Q4 FY26, as Q4 is normally better than Q3.
items.quote: And we do believe that normally, Q4 is much better than Q3 for this business. So we do feel the growth rates and the absolute numbers should get better.

items.statement: New car industry saw unprecedented growth and volumes in October-December 2025, benefiting the consumer group.
items.quote: The new car industry in the last 2 months has done extremely well. And like we said, we are obviously beneficiaries of the car industry itself.

items.statement: Used car demand is expected to grow massively over the next 12-15 months following new car price reductions, after a 1-3 month lag for price adjustment.
items.quote: So you'll see a massive growth in the used product industry in the n ext 12 to 15 months, which follows typically the new product price decreases

items.statement: Adjusted EBITDA (cash proxy) crossed INR100 crores for the first time, reaching INR101 crores in Q3 FY26.
items.quote: Adjusted EBITDA reached INR101 crores. It's a cash proxy. It's the first time it's crossed INR100 crores in the quarter.

items.statement: Cash reserves stand at INR1,145 crores as of Q3 FY26.
items.quote: and the execution capability. If you look at the center block, it shows that our cash reserves have gone back to INR1,145 crores

items.statement: Company has almost no capex requirement in current business.
items.quote: We have almost no capex in the company and almost no need from an investment standpoint in our current business, all our businesses are high-margin businesses.

items.statement: Operating costs are stable and not expected to change; incremental revenue largely flows to margins.
items.quote: We think expenses are stable. They're not likely to see any fluctuation or any incremental change at all. So they're not likely to change.

items.statement: Elite Buyer program on OLX saw very high traction in the last 30-40 days and is expected to become a flagship revenue earner.
items.quote: The Elite Buyer actually done extremely well in the last quarter. It was really commercially fully launched in the last quarter, and we feel very good about the adoption of the Elite Buyer program.

items.statement: OLX Verification product to launch in next 30 days to enhance trust and safety on the platform.
items.quote: Other products like Verification, is likely to be launched in the next 30 days or so, it is completely a new product to further enhance customer experience on trust and safety on the platform.

items.statement: Used car financing marketplace products being developed with large banks and NBFCs, expected to launch in next few quarters.
items.quote: I think in the next few quarters, you'll see products like that launched for used cars where our relevance is very high.

items.statement: Combined CarWale and OLX dealer subscription launched to increase dealer base for both platforms.
items.quote: For the first time, combined the CarWale OLX offering for all dealers in India. So we launched a subscription for dealers, which is combined of OLX and CarWale to increase the base for both companies.

items.statement: Management believes CarWale is gaining market share in digital ad spend due to higher relevance and efficiency for manufacturers and dealers.
items.quote: We also feel among digital advertising platforms, whether if a manufacturer is advertising on us or other horizontals, we feel we offer a far of value to dealers and consumers. So we see a clear increase in our market share in spends.

items.statement: INR6.5 crores labor code provision made in Q3 FY26 due to new regulation, reducing PAT growth to 35% YoY vs 49% without it.
items.quote: This is primarily due to an extraordinary item of the Labor code provision as per the new regulation being provided INR6.5 crores during the quarter.

items.statement: No immediate capital allocation plan; cash generation of ~INR100 crores/quarter will be used for potential inorganic opportunities or returned to shareholders long-term.
items.quote: So the intent would be, to look at whether any inorganic opportunities come in the future. And we've been very good at acquisitions in the past. We've done multiple successful acquisitions. So part of the use, if at all, we come across an opportunity would be that. And obviously , the long-term intent would be to return money to shareholders.

items.statement: Significant ongoing investment in AI, product engineering, and design talent; CarTrade Laboratories created for cutting-edge products.
items.quote: A large part of our team is product engineering, design and AI talent. So we're building products for OLX, CarWale, SAMIL every single day and new products as well. We also created CarTrade Laboratories, which builds only new cutting-edge products few months ago.

items.statement: Consumer group revenue grew 32% YoY in 9M FY26; EBITDA grew 106% YoY.
items.quote: If you look at the 9 -month numbers, the consumer group has done extremely well with a 32% growth in revenue, 106% growth in EBITDA and a 74% growth in PBT, with a 51% growth in PAT.

items.statement: OLX revenue grew 18% YoY in Q3 FY26 to INR61.7 crores; EBITDA grew 70% YoY.
items.quote: OLX, it has had its highest ever revenue in any quarter. It's crossed INR61.7 crores and INR58 crores in operating revenue, which is up 18%. Profitability or EBITDA is up 70

items.statement: Remarketing business revenue grew 22% YoY in 9M FY26; EBITDA grew 57% YoY.
items.quote: And if you look at the 9 -month figures, 22% up in revenue, 57% increase in EBITDA and an 80% growth in PAT for the year.

items.statement: Consolidated revenue grew 18% YoY in Q3 FY26; operating revenue grew 19% YoY.
items.quote: If we go to Slide 6 and look at the consolidated results of the company, revenue is up 18%. Operating revenue is up 19

items.statement: Consolidated 9M FY26 revenue grew 24% YoY; EBITDA grew 77% YoY; margins at 32%.
items.quote: If you look at the 9-month results of the company, revenue is up 24%, EBITDA up 77%. The 9-month margins come at 32% and the PAT is at 74%.

items.statement: CarDekho acquisition pursuit was put on hold after due diligence; diligence costs incurred in Q3 FY26.
items.quote: We did announce that we were pursuing the transaction, and we then after studying it, at that point, decided to put it on hold. I think the reasons mostly were around understanding, obviously, the potential in our own business seems so high that we said, is this the right time for that or not.

items.statement: Management does not share proprietary data with LLMs; sees data moat as key competitive advantage against AI disintermediation.
items.quote: On licensing and sharing content, no, we don't share our proprietary content or our own data with LLMs at all in any licensing arrangement. We think the data we've got and the brand we have and the platform we have is a differentiator or is differentiated, and we would not want to be licensing or sharing it with anybody else.

items.statement: Targets Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin of 14%-15%
items.quote: And once we do start these projects, you know, from Q4 and Q1 onwards, you will see these expenses remaining the same, whereas our top lines will go further up and then will contribute to a similar margin of approximately 14%-15% in this Q4 as well. That is what we are targeting.

items.statement: Targets full year FY26 export contribution of 5%
items.quote: The company remains confident on achieving its full year export contribution of 5%, and has laid out a clear roadmap to scale exports to double-digits by FY '27.

items.statement: Targets double-digit export contribution by end of FY28
items.quote: The double-digit growth will take us a couple of years. Sorry sir there is -- it will be basically FY '28 is when we reach – by end of FY '28 is when we reach a double-digit growth.

items.statement: Targets FY27 Tipping Jack revenue of INR45-50 crores
items.quote: Well, next year, at least a year ahead, I can tell you in FY '27, we are targeting revenues of approximately INR45 crores to INR50 crores.

items.statement: Targets tractor segment contribution of 15-16% of revenue in 1.5 years
items.quote: And total tractor exposure is at 11%, which with the addition of this new customer and new developments with our existing customers, we plan to take it to around 15% to 16% of our revenue in a year and a half time.

items.statement: Targets trailer axle market share of 35% with extrusion line
items.quote: So, we of course want to become the leaders in the market. But what we will be looking at, we would like to reach a market share of about 35% with this improvement in technology.

items.statement: IPO proceeds 90% deployed, balance 10% to be deployed within FY26
items.quote: Just to update our investors on our IPO proceeds, we have approximately spent 90% of the proceeds. These have already been deployed, and the balance 10% will fully be deployed within FY '26, which has been previously guided by us.

items.statement: Seamless tube facility construction completed, capex outside IPO proceeds
items.quote: The capex for the seamless tube is left. The capex of the IPO proceeds mostly have been completed. But there is a lot of part of the seamless tube expansion which is still left out, but that is from the out of the scope of the IPO proceeds.

items.statement: FY26 capex expected around INR80-90 crores
items.quote: So, this around INR60 crores of capex that we incurred in the first half, maybe by the year-end we should be around INR80 crores, INR90 crores odd?

items.statement: FY27 capex mainly for balance payments on seamless tube project
items.quote: The next year capex levels mostly are going to be towards the balance payments for our seamless tube project. And the incremental capex expense that we need to do every year.

items.statement: Axle beam extrusion plant trials underway, commissioning expected by February 2026, to enhance axle manufacturing capacity by ~50%
items.quote: Trials for the axle beam extrusion plant are currently underway, with commissioning expected by February '26. Upon commissioning, the facility is expected to enhance axle manufacturing capacity by approximately 50%.

items.statement: Seamless tube facility construction completed
items.quote: In addition, construction of the seamless tube facility has been completed.

items.statement: Forging capacity expanded with 2,000-ton, 1,000-ton screw presses commissioned, 1,600-ton under commissioning for February completion
items.quote: The company has also expanded its forging capabilities by commissioning a 2,000-ton screw press, a 1,000-ton screw press, and now, additionally, a 1,600-ton screw press is under commissioning, and it will be completed in the month of February.

items.statement: Forging utilization at 60-65%, expected to reach 65-68% with new presses; machining utilization at 70-75%
items.quote: The utilization levels in the forging are at approximately between 60% to 65%. We usually plan our forging infrastructure a little in advance because it takes time to install and commission these machines and most of these machines are imported for us. The regular machining capacity utilization is at around 70% to 75%.

items.statement: Extruded axle line installed capacity 7,500 beams/month, current volume 4,000 axles/month, targets full utilization by end FY27
items.quote: We have an installed capacity of 7,500 extruded beams with the line which we have set up right now. And we are at a current volume of 4,000 axles per month. So, in the next 1.5 years, we should be -- in the end of next financial year, we should be looking to utilize this whole capacity of ours of 7,500.

items.statement: Tipping Jack manufacturing capacity 800 assemblies/month, currently at 350-400 units, targets peak capacity in FY27
items.quote: As far as our capacity for manufacturing, this Tipping Jacks is close to 800 assemblies a month. It will take us maybe the whole financial year FY '27 to come to the peak capacity.

items.statement: M&HCV segment growth returned after 7 quarters, driven by dumper, tipper, prime mover production increase from October 2025
items.quote: For the first time in seven quarters, the company witnessed growth in the M&HCV segment. The segment had remained subdued over the past seven quarters. However, from October '25 onwards, both key OEMs, Tata Motors and Ashok Leyland, have reported a sharp increase in production volumes.

items.statement: Trailer segment demand pickup supporting H2 volume growth, added 5 new fabricator customers in Q3
items.quote: The trailer segment has also witnessed a noticeable pickup in demand, further supporting volume growth in the second half of the year. The company added five new fabricator customers during the quarter.

items.statement: Tractor segment grew 16% in 9M FY26, strong momentum into Q4, earlier schedule visibility from February
items.quote: The company's tractor segment delivered healthy revenue growth of 16% during the nine months of FY '26, with strong momentum carrying into Q4. We have also witnessed an earlier-than-usual improvement in the schedule visibility, with OEM production schedules increasing meaningfully from February itself, which typically accelerates from April.

items.statement: Q3 FY26 EBITDA margin 13.2%, 9M FY26 EBITDA margin 12.1%
items.quote: EBITDA margins for this quarter stood at 13.2%.

items.statement: Other expenses increased to 26.5% of sales in Q3 from 24.5% in Q3 FY25 due to consumables, tooling for new projects not yet reflecting in revenue
items.quote: Now, just to give a little flavor on the other expenses, which basically constitute into - these are a large variety of consumables and spares. Now, we have a lot of ongoing projects, you know, things like the extrusion, new components for the exports - that is for Leax, even the Tipping jack business, which has just started off.

items.statement: Expects other expenses to reduce to 22-23% as new project revenues ramp up from Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27
items.quote: Now, once we see the effect of these new projects and products coming into our top line, you will see that the total percentage of the other expenses starts reducing back to around 22% to 23%, which was there at 24% in the last year.

items.statement: Gross margins expected to be maintained despite steel price hikes from December, OEM compensation expected
items.quote: However, I think we should be able to maintain same gross margins, the fact that we will be compensated by the OEMs for the steel price hikes, but gross margins will vary between these percentages. 1% or 2% up can be there.

items.statement: Q4 axle order book at 4,000 axles/month for February-March, Q3 volumes 8,300 axles, 9M axle revenue INR185 crores vs INR188 crores FY25
items.quote: As compared to, if you look into what our Q4 volumes are, we are looking at a volume of 4,000 axles a month. This is the kind of an order book right now we have as compared to, if you see what February and March, what we are planning that is 4,000 axles on a monthly basis.

items.statement: Export orders secured from European Tier 1 across two product families, supplier approval obtained for one family, trial orders received
items.quote: Purchase orders were secured from a leading Tier 1 company in Europe across two distinct product families. Samples were successfully dispatched, and the supplier approval has been obtained for one family of parts, against which trial orders have already been received.

items.statement: Leax export business targeting INR28-30 crores in FY26, plans to double in FY27
items.quote: If you look into our Leax business, this year, we would be approximately doing INR28 crores to INR30 crores in our export business. The other two, three components with the same customer are, you know, now in production. And I think by next year, we should be able to double this revenue, what we have planned for this year.

items.statement: Launched Tipping Jack for trailer segment, validation underway, 35-40 assemblies dispatched, commercial launch targeted January-February 2026
items.quote: We will like to launch this product sometime in January or February this year. We have already, you know, dispatched close to about 35 or 40 assemblies in the field.

items.statement: Added 5 new fabricator customers in Q3, expanding beyond Rajasthan, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh into Gujarat and Maharashtra
items.quote: The company added five new fabricator customers during the quarter. Continued focus on expanding the fabricator customer base is further strengthening the market penetration and improving demand visibility in this segment.

items.statement: Added new tractor customer, meaningful revenues expected from Q1 FY27
items.quote: But obviously it takes time to build business on it. It starts all with a sample stage and then you need to set up a dedicated production line for them. So that's only going to come in, if you ask me meaningful revenues to come out of it is going to be from Q1 onwards.

items.statement: Exports 4% of 9M FY26 revenue, grew 14% YoY, 99% to Europe, 0-4% customs duty paid by customer
items.quote: Exports contributed 4% of our total revenue during FY '26, that is for the nine months, registering a growth of 14%.

items.statement: New European Tier 1 customer samples under validation, expects revenue from Q1 FY27 for at least two products
items.quote: We've added another new Tier 1 company for which, as I told you, samples and everything have been sent. It's under validation. We should be starting doing some revenues from Q1 of this coming year with at least two of the products.

items.statement: Raw material inventory 30-40 days, varies by grade and size due to single-source requirements
items.quote: We hold approximately an inventory of 30 days to 40 days, especially during a busy month. Actually, the thing is that there are various grades and sizes that we use.

items.statement: Q3 FY26 revenue INR177.5 crores, up 18.1% YoY; 9M FY26 revenue INR447.8 crores, up 2.8% YoY
items.quote: Revenue for us stood at INR177.5 crores, reflecting a growth of 18.1% on a year-on-year basis.

items.statement: Q3 FY26 EBITDA INR23.5 crores, up 18.9% YoY; PAT INR14 crores, up 3% YoY
items.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR23.5 crores, representing a year-on-year growth of 18.9% compared to INR19.7 crores in Q3 of FY '25.

items.statement: Trailer axle & suspension 40.7% of Q3 revenue, other components (CV, exports, tractors) 59.3%
items.quote: The revenue contribution in terms of a sales mix from trailer axles and suspension stood at 40.7%, while the other component business, which includes CV components, exports and tractors, stood at 59.3% in Q3.

items.statement: FY26 revenue guidance INR140-150 crore and EBITDA around INR32 crore
items.quote: As a part of t he company, it takes immense proud for me to reiterate that the revenue guidance given remains intact and we will be accomplishing INR140 crores to INR150 crores supported by volume growth, improving operational efficiencies and disciplined project execution

items.statement: Target 5x revenue and EBITDA by FY28
items.quote: While remaining confident in its ability to drive sustained profitability and achieve a five-fold increase in revenue and EBITDA by financial year 28, the company continues to mai ntain a strong and achievable five -fold increase in revenue and EBITDA by FY28

items.statement: Brownfield capex INR7-8 crore for new crushing line; Greenfield capex INR11-12 crore spent so far; total IPO capex plan INR44.5 crore with INR36 crore remaining
items.quote: On the deployment of IPO proceeds, out of the total 44.5 crore capex embarked, the current capex which has been finished is around 15.18 on the capital plan.

items.statement: Capacity expanded from 132,000 to 256,000 MTPA; Greenfield to reach 574,000 MTPA by Q1 FY27; MIGPL capacity 50,000 to 65,000 MTPA by Q4 FY26
items.quote: We remain fully committed to inaugurating this facility by Q1 FY27, which will take our total installed capacity to approximately 5.74 lakh metric ton per annum, positioning Monolithisch as the largest ramming mass manufacturer in the world.

items.statement: Q3 capacity utilization 80-81% on 256,000 MTPA
items.quote: Q3 is roughly around 80%, 80% to 81%.

items.statement: EBITDA margin 23.9% in Q3; sustainable range 22-26%; target ROCE 26-30%
items.quote: Sir, we are looking to be somewhere around 22% to 26% of EBITDA. 22% being on the lowest side and 26% being on the highest side. Currently, we are running around 23% or 24%, I believe.

items.statement: New SGB Limited product 15-20% superior lifespan; expect 50-60% customers to switch from SGB 777 in next couple months; higher EBITDA margins
items.quote: On the product side, the transition from SGB 777 to SGB Limited is going to be the new key driving factor in Q4 with 15 % to 20% superior lifespan. We expect high growth customers to switch from SGB 777 to SGB Limited and this switching will enhance our premium realizations and better profitability for them.

items.statement: Average selling price ~INR8/kg; stone cost INR2.2-2.6/kg; additives INR1-1.7/kg; prices rise INR400-500/kg every 1-1.5 years
items.quote: Sir, this year, overall, the prices have been somewhere near to INR8 per kg. Okay? And, you know, in almost every one, one and a half year, it tends to increase by INR400 to INR500 due to the cost that comes slightly through the raw materials.

items.statement: Boric acid and boron oxide additives imported, dollar-linked; company keeps 2-3 months inventory to manage price volatility
items.quote: Regarding the COGS, we remain largely dependent on additives, boric acid, boron oxide from our customers, which is again dependent on dollars. As we mentioned in the last quarter itself, that whatever impact of boric acid or boron oxide or the additives that comes to us, what we -- how we try to manage that is we try to be 2-3 months ahead.

items.statement: Demand momentum intact despite steel industry headwinds; Eastern India 60% of induction furnace steel output; target 25% market share
items.quote: Despite headwinds faced by end users in the steel industry and the world, demand momentum for our company remained largely intact, keeping us well positioned to sustain our growth trajectory.

items.statement: Exports minimal: INR10-15 lakh/month to Nepal, INR15-20 lakh/month to Bangladesh via traders; planning Rajasthan plant near Mundra port for exports
items.quote: Sir, right now, we are doing around, I am giving you a ballpark figure of INR10 lakhs to INR15 lakhs a month to Nepal. The location where we are located is very suitable for Nepal and Bangladesh.

items.statement: Cash conversion cycle 51 days (66 debtor, 6 inventory, 21 creditor days); expect sharp improvement in Q4 as inventory and debtor days decline
items.quote: So, the total conversion cycle for December '25 was 51 days, 66 days for debtors, 6 days inventory and 21 days creditors.

items.statement: Net debt negligible (<0.3%); cash position INR3.5 crore from operations; INR36 crore IPO proceeds in bank
items.quote: Sir, net debt remains almost negligible. So, I think it should be less than what? 0.3% or something.

items.statement: IPO proceeds INR44.5 crore capex plan; INR36 crore remaining; INR5-6 crore to be converted to working capital
items.quote: INR36 crores is left with us, which is in the bank.

items.statement: Acquired 100% of Mineral India Global (MIGPL) effective 8 Nov 2025 at book value INR399.60; MIGPL earns INR10-11 crore/year
items.quote: As previously committed, Monolithisch India has acquired 100% stake in Mineral India Global Private Limited, making it a wholly owned subsidiary effective 8th November, 2025.

items.statement: Labour Code changes may slightly increase costs; automation reduced crushing labour 20-30% offsetting impact
items.quote: Sir, there will be a slight increment in the entire situation because there are a lot of changes that have been put in. But we are still evaluating it. The good part is that the earlier crusher line that we had and the crusher line that we have now, we have almost reduced the crushing labour to 20%-30%, okay?

items.statement: Ramming mass market ~2-3 lakh tons/month in India; Eastern region 60%; current share 10-12% India, 17-18% domestic; target 25%
items.quote: You can expect that the ramming mass industry right now requires somewhere around 2 to 3 lakh tons a month in which whatever volume we are doing and our counterparts are doing, and rest is done by the unorganized sector.

items.statement: Greenfield commissioning timeline risk (Q1 FY27 target); demand absorption risk for 5x capacity; export logistics cost challenge
items.quote: But, you know, I mean, I would rather want you to follow the guidance that we gave on a quarterly basis because we are into manufacturing industry. Okay. Serving to steel industry. So, I just want to make sure that whatever guidance comes from my mouth has to be, 10%-20%, 25% deviation, not more than that.

items.statement: Automation reduced crushing labour 20-30%; evaluating Labour Code impact
items.quote: The good part is that the earlier crusher line that we had and the crusher line that we have now, we have almost reduced the crushing labour to 20%-30%, okay?

items.statement: Recognized in Forbes India DGEMS 2025 Select 200 Companies with Global Business Potential
items.quote: I would also want to highlight that Monolithisch India Limited has been recognized among the Forbes India DGEMS 2025 Select 200 Companies with Global Business Potential, highlighting its strong scalability, innovation, and global growth ambitions.

items.statement: Targets double-digit revenue growth for FY27, not lower than 10%
items.quote: We will not be looking at any number which is lower than a double-digit growth. That's what I said. And slightly premature to give you a guidance. Maybe the next call, I will be able to indicate with certainty.

items.statement: Targets EBITDA margin of 18% as intermediate goal
items.quote: On the margins front, we have already moved from the 16% odd to (+17%). And like I said in my opening remarks, the direction is going towards 18%. That's the broad guidance I can give you at this point.

items.statement: FY26 capex expected at Rs. 350 crores, FY27 capex around Rs. 250 crores with 25-30% replacement
items.quote: As far as capital expenditure is concerned, we will probably finish the year FY26 with around Rs. 350 crores. And I expect our CAPEX to be around Rs. 250 crores next year. And the CAPEX will start contributing. And like I said, about 25% to 30% percent based on past experience is replaced in capital expenditure.

items.statement: Overall capacity utilization around 60%, varies by business line
items.quote: So, we have many businesses, and it varies from business to business, line to line, assembly to assembly. So, while it's difficult to put a number across the company, one number, but each unit will have its own capacity utilization and equipment effectiveness. So broadly, just to make it easy for you, I would say probably we are at 60% capacity utilization.

items.statement: Wind energy business expanded from Rs. 200 crores to Rs. 350 crores annualized, targeting Rs. 500 crores
items.quote: With respect to the wind energy where we have had the first phase of expansion and moved the numbers from Rs. 200 odd crores to Rs. 350 crores on an annualized basis. With the further expansion of the wind energy business, we are looking to take it up to close to Rs. 500 crores on an annualized basis.

items.statement: Aerospace business grew 50-60% to Rs. 5 crores monthly from Rs. 2.5-3 crores
items.quote: With respect to our aerospace partners where we have been hovering around on a monthly basis about Rs. 2.5 crores to Rs. 3 crores. We have seen a jump of it touching close to Rs. 5 crores which is witnessing a 50% to 60% growth.

items.statement: Domestic segment grew 18% in Q3 across OE and aftermarket
items.quote: We have registered 18% growth in the domestic segment in both our OE and aftermarket business put together.

items.statement: Export moderated due to tariff pressures, North America down from 70% to 60-62% of exports
items.quote: While there has been some contraction in the North American market comprising of US, Mexico and Canada, which generally used to be at about 70% or so. Now, we are seeing that between 60% to 62%.

items.statement: 9M EBITDA margin at 17.3%, gross margin at RMC stage about 60%
items.quote: The 9-month number somewhat mirrors the quarterly performance with strong domestic performance and moderating exports. Our contribution has been better for the 9-month period, about almost 1% higher than for the quarter and the EBITDA is at 17.3% for the 9-month period.

items.statement: Tariffs of 25-50% impacting contribution margin, fixed costs stable
items.quote: The only element which as expected is the tariff and the full brunt of the tariff has started impacting and some of our products are at 25%, some of them are 50% depending on the iron and steel content and that has had an impact at the contribution stage.

items.statement: Non-auto revenue share increased to 38% from 30% due to export drop
items.quote: Non-auto currently, non-auto which comprises of aerospace. The aerospace, right way and wind energy, tractors, aftermarket segments comprise 38% roughly of our revenues today from about 30% or it has moved to 30%. That is because of the drop in export revenues.

items.statement: Fasteners 40-45% of domestic revenue
items.quote: In the overall domestic revenue, fasteners would be about 40% to 45%.

items.statement: Increased share of business with existing customers in commercial and tractor segments
items.quote: As we said last time, those RFQs, some of them are matured and some are in the final stages of discussion and on the existing customers share with quite a few customers, we have increased share of business also, both on the commercial side as well as on the tractor side.

items.statement: Europe export share increased from 20% to 25%, ASEAN also growing
items.quote: And the presence in Europe, which used to be about 20%, now we are seeing that inching up to 25%. So, broadly, the shift is 3% to 5% drop in North America, followed by increase in Europe and the ASEAN region.

items.statement: Borrowings reduced due to better working capital management and lower inventory
items.quote: The borrowings have come down because of better working capital management, lower inventory, relatively lower inventory and the depreciation impact has slightly come down because of lesser capitalization.

items.statement: Exceptional item of Rs. 11 crores for labour code provision
items.quote: may have noticed that like all companies which have Sundram Fasteners January 29, 2026 provided for the labour code impact, we have also taken an exceptional hit of Rs. 11 crores

items.statement: Domestic growth driven by M&HCV, cars/MUV, and tractors segments
items.quote: I think in the domestic market, the pickup or growth, it centres around the cars, M&HCV segment for us and with strong presence in tractors. So those are the three segments which is driving the growth in domestic segment.

items.statement: Industry outlook: MHCV 8-10%, cars 8-10%, tractors 10%+ growth for FY27
items.quote: See next year, going forward, the rough indications coming for the commercial vehicle segment is roughly 8% to 10% growth over this year. And on the fast car segment also, it is around 8% to 10% and on the tractors, upwards of 10% is what is being indicated right now.

items.statement: Aims to outperform industry by 2% (12% vs 10% industry growth)

items.statement: Net debt to EBITDA at 1.4x as of December 31, 2025 with net debt of ₹1,667 crore

items.statement: Weighted average cost of funds reduced to 6.82% at portfolio level after renegotiating dollar denominated loans
items.quote: After December 31, 2025, we successfully negotiated better rates for our dollar denominated loans, reducing the weighted average cost of funds at portfolio level to 6.82%, now the lowest in the peer group.

items.statement: Expecting 10 bps reduction in rupee denominated loans cost of funds
items.quote: As we speak, we are negotiating with lenders for rupee denominated loans, and we expect 10 bps reduction that will bring down our average cost of funds further.

items.statement: Offshore Maldivian debt cost decreased to 7.02% with further 70 bps reduction post quarter-end
items.quote: For our offshore Maldivian assets, the cost decreased 7.02%, marking a reduction of 0.28% from the previous quarter. Post the quarter-end, we have successfully renegotiated our offshore debt and would see a reduction of at least 70 basis points in the Maldivian portfolio.

items.statement: Hilton Goa acquisition and Soho House investment funded entirely from internal accruals
items.quote: Everything is funded from our internal accruals.

items.statement: India RevPAR grew 15% to around ₹8,300 and TRevPAR to around ₹16,000 in Q3 FY26
items.quote: resulting in RevPAR growth of 15% to around ₹8,300 and TRevPAR to around ₹16,000.

items.statement: Hilton Goa expected to generate ₹40 crore annual EBITDA post renovation with ₹25 lakh EBITDA per key
items.quote: We expect EBITDA per key will go to around ₹25 lakh EBITDA per key, and this hotel will generate annual EBITDA of around ₹40 crore for us, post renovation, repositioning, rebranding in a stabilized year.

items.statement: Maharashtra government announced GCC policy offering fiscal incentives to attract global capability centres, expected to benefit Pune disproportionately
items.quote: The Maharashtra government recently announced its GCC policy, offering fiscal incentives to attract global capability centres in Maharashtra, which is expected to benefit Pune disproportionately, giving us clear visibility on medium to long-term demand growth.

items.statement: India occupancy stable at 62% due to one-off external factors like airline disruption, not structural demand issues
items.quote: Occupancy in India was stable at 62% due to the one-off external factors such as the airline disruption and not due to any structural demand issue.

items.statement: Expects growth momentum to continue in Q4 FY26 and break records month after month
items.quote: we expect this growth momentum to continue this coming quarter. And this quarter also, all the indications are quite buoyant, and we expect that we should be breaking records month after month.

items.statement: Broad-based demand across all auto segments with record production and sales volumes in Q3 FY26
items.quote: supported by a strong broad-based demand across all segments as the auto industry witnessed a very strong operating environment and reported record production and sales volumes during the quarter.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA grew 21% YoY in Q3 FY26 driven by operating leverage and cost optimization
items.quote: Consolidated EBITDA also witnessed a very strong growth of 21% year-on-year in Q3 FY '26. This g rowth in profitability was driven by improved operating leverage and the company's continuous focus on productivity, cost optimization and operational efficiency

items.statement: Antolin entities breaking records post-acquisition with healthy new program pipeline
items.quote: post closure of the Antolin M&A takeover, we have had our initial meetings and all the figures look extremely positive. And we are seeing that they also are breaking all various records that they have done earlier to be beating the numbers in this quarter.

items.statement: Signed asset purchase agreement with Sunbeam Lightweighting for piston manufacturing lines for INR280 million
items.quote: This includes the si gning of an asset purchase agreement with Sunbeam Lightweighting Solutions Private Limited, a wholly -owned subsidiary of Craftsman Automation Limited, to acquire piston manufacturing lines and related machinery and assets for a total consideration of INR280 million

items.statement: Sufficient capacity available after Sunbeam acquisition; other expansions cover requirements for at least 2+ quarters
items.quote: thanks to that, we have now fairly good capacities available, and we can scale up very fast. And most of the other places, we have put in all required capacity expansion to be able to take care of all the requirements of expansion that we see in the coming at least 2 quarters plus more.

items.statement: Powertrain-agnostic products to exceed 35% of consolidated revenue post-Antolin consolidation
items.quote: Post the consolidation of Antolin India operations within SPRL, the overall sales revenue of the powertrain-agnostic products would increase to over 35% of the consolidated revenue, including previous acquisitions of TGPEL, Takahata and EMFI.

items.statement: Completed 100% acquisition of Grupo Antolin's three Indian entities at EUR159 million enterprise value
items.quote: The transaction was completed in the first week of January 2026 at an enterprise value of EUR159 million or INR16,700 million approximately on a debt-free cash-free basis.

items.statement: Board approved interim dividend at 50% of face value (INR 5 per equity share)
items.quote: the Board has approved an interim dividend at 50% of face value, that is INR 5 per equit y share, during the meeting held yesterday

items.statement: Raised INR1,000 crores NCDs with 2-year tenure in 2 tranches, primarily for acquisition funding
items.quote: The tenure is for 2 years, and we plan to take it in 2 tranches. And we plan to pay off as soon as possible.

items.statement: Exports grew well despite tough geopolitical situation; won new business in North America
items.quote: Exports also have done quite well, even with a very tough and a very difficult geopolitical situation that was existing till around a week back. I think, up to December, it was a very, very tough kind of a market situation. But our teams have done well to get newer markets, work on newer programs, work on newer areas, thereby helping us to actually improve our sales.

items.statement: Raw material cost pass-through to customers typically has a 1-quarter lag
items.quote: it has normally a lag because we also carry inventories in the pipeline. So in most of the cases, it is a lag which is of 1 quarter.

items.statement: Customer concentration has come down drastically; well represented across all OEMs with no single customer >10-20% in subsidiaries
items.quote: our customer concentration has come d own drastically. Because of all the mix that we have and the product segmentation that we have now, we are fairly well represented in almost all the OEMs. Name any OEM and we are there

items.statement: Electric motors and controllers business expected to grow 5x-7x YoY from small base
items.quote: I think from last year to this year, we would grow almost like 5x to 7x. And I think, since the base is small, that growth will continue. So we expect our growth in the motor and controller segment to really grow well.

items.statement: Exceptional expense of INR252 million for statutory impact of new Labour Codes introduced November 2025
items.quote: During the quarter, of course, there was a nonrecurring exceptional expense of Rs. 252 million pertaining to the statutory impact of the new Labo ur Codes introduced by the government in November 2025

items.statement: No market share lost to competitors; in fact grown share in almost all segments
items.quote: we have lost not a single share, not even 1% share, to any of our competitors. Number two, we have, in fact, grown our market share in almost all segments of the business.

items.statement: Subsidiary management structures retained with central core team support for agility and quick decisions
items.quote: the structure that we have followed and we find that, that is really working very well for us is to ensure that the existing management structures in the subsidiaries are able to work along with a core group of the central management team, which is able to give all the support that it requires in terms of all the growth requirements and everything, thereby ensuring that we are able to be very agil

items.statement: Board approved merger of Badve Autocomps and Eximius Infra Tech with Belrise at ~8.3x FY25 P/E, EPS and value accretive from day one
items.quote: The Board has approved the proposed merger of Badve Autocomps Private Limited and Eximius Infra Tech Solutions Private Limited with our listed entity, Belrise Industries.

items.statement: Merger adds ~INR10bn revenue post RPT elimination, combined PAT ~INR1.1bn, EBITDA margins 12-13%
items.quote: Post-merger, net of related party eliminations, we expect an incremental INR10 billion of revenue to be added to Belrise, along with a margin uplift driven by the internal RPT net-offs.

items.statement: Merger to reduce related party transactions by ~INR11.5bn and increase content per vehicle by ~INR3,000 to ~INR20,300
items.quote: Firstly, the merger will result in a significantly simplified group structure, with r elated-party transactions reducing materially by close to INR11.5 billion

items.statement: Acquired French aerospace firm SDM for EUR0.35m (~0.1x sales), supplies to largest commercial aircraft OEM and French fighter OEM
items.quote: The acquisition was completed at an attractive valuation. SDM is expected to generate revenues of approximately EUR3-4 million in FY '27, while the acquisition was done at a consideration of EUR0.35 million, implying an entry valuation of approximately 0.1x sales.

items.statement: Strategic collaboration with Israel's Plasan Sasa to industrialize ATEMM platform in India and join global supply chain
items.quote: We will team with Plasan in India to jointly engage with the MOD, defense PSUs, and other relevant stakeholders, to industrialize and productionize the ATEMM solution for the Indian ecosystem.

items.statement: Maintain annual guidance to outperform 2-wheeler industry substantially and deliver mid-teens revenue growth
items.quote: We maintain our guidance about outperforming the industry in two-wheelers substantially and also kind of maintaining that mid-teens kind of revenue growth going forward.

items.statement: Target to double 4-wheeler and CV revenue in next two years vs FY25
items.quote: Our guidance, which is to double our four-wheeler and commercial vehicle revenue in the next two years as compared to FY25 numbers.

items.statement: Secured strategic order for new Haridwar plant for largest 2-wheeler OEM; Chennai plant ramped up for EV platform; Bhiwadi plant started supplies for premium Japanese model
items.quote: During the quarter, we secured a strategic order t o establish a new manufacturing plant in Haridwar for one of India's largest 2-wheeler

items.statement: Three new facilities (Chennai EV, Bhiwadi Japanese OEM, Haridwar) to ramp up in Q4 FY26
items.quote: In the coming quarter, I think we'll get a lot of help of the upcoming facilities - the one in Chennai for the leading EV platform for a two-wheeler OEM, the Bhiwadi facility where we're supplying to a premium Japanese two-wheeler OEM, as well as the Haridwar facility for a leading two-wheeler OEM.

items.statement: Content per vehicle for top OEM rose from INR12,500 to ~INR18,000 (45% increase) via steering columns and merger additions
items.quote: We've already gone from INR12,500 to INR14,000 with the addition of steering columns. And with this acquisition, with the same OEM, we've gone close to INR17,000 and as we speak, we're also in discussions with them for two new products, which we think can take it from INR17,000 to upwards of INR18,000 over this fiscal year.

items.statement: Suspension, steering columns, high-tensile each targeted as multi-hundred crore verticals in 2-3 years
items.quote: I think it would be pretty fair to say that each of them going forward can be multi-hundred crore businesses. And this way we're talking about a medium-term perspective in the next two to three years.

items.statement: Q3 FY26 EBITDA margin 12.3%, manufacturing EBITDA margin 14.0%; 9M EBITDA margin stable at 12.4%
items.quote: EBITDA stood at INR2,869 million, up 10% Y-o-Y in Q3 FY25. EBITDA margins stood at 12.3%.

items.statement: Merger entities have EBITDA margins 12-13%, in line with Belrise; RPT elimination to lift consolidated margins
items.quote: if you look at the EBIT DA margins of these two entities, they stay close to 12 % to 13%. So fairly in line with what Belrise EBITDA margins are

items.statement: 2-wheeler revenues flat sequentially (INR15,085m Q2 vs INR15,041m Q3); 9M 2-wheeler up 12% YoY outperforming industry
items.quote: In terms of revenues, the company's two-wheeler revenues remain largely flat on a sequential basis. So, we were around INR15,085 million in Q2 FY26 and right now we're at around INR15,041 million in Q2 FY26.

items.statement: PV revenue dip due to supply chain issues at largest European OEM and Bhiwadi plant transition; 9M PV up 24% YoY
items.quote: Firstly, in this quarter, there were some supply chain issues with one of our largest Europe-based four-wheeler OEMs, which is a premium automaker.

items.statement: Exports 5.8% of manufacturing revenue in Q3 (INR1,075m); 5.6% in 9M (INR3,127m)
items.quote: Exports contributed 5.8% to our manufacturing revenue in Q3 FY26, that is INR1,075 million.

items.statement: Net debt INR7,767m as of Dec 31, 2025; ROACE 15.1%
items.quote: Net debt as of 31st December 2025 stood at INR7,767 million and ROAC E stood at 15.1

items.statement: Effective tax rate normalized to 20-24% range for the year
items.quote: Over the course of the year, we've seen this normalize to around 20% to 24% of corporate tax rate.

items.statement: Merger adds ~2,000 employees (1,550 blue-collar, 400 white-collar); operations highly automated with 50 robots, 30 moulding machines
items.quote: The merger will add approximately 2,000 employees to the Belrise family, including around 1,550 blue-collar workers and 400 white-collar employees.

items.statement: Post-merger 2-wheeler plastic market share ~25% (Belrise ~10% + merging entities ~14%)
items.quote: Post-merger, the combined entity will command nearly a 25% market share in 2-wheeler plastic components.

items.statement: Content per vehicle target for top OEMs raised from INR17,300 to ~INR20,300 post-merger
items.quote: Beyond the guided content per vehicle of INR17,300 for Belrise, we see an incremental increase of around INR3,000, taking consolidated content per vehicle to approximately INR20,300.

items.statement: Now supply suspensions to 4 large 2-wheeler OEMs (from 2 at start of year); steering columns to all Indian OEMs + European OEM
items.quote: in suspensions, we started the year supplying to only 2 O EMs. Now, we're supplying to 4 OEMs. These are all really large OEMs that we're working with

items.statement: Entered supply chain of 6 aerospace/defense OEMs including largest commercial aircraft OEM and French fighter OEM via SDM acquisition
items.quote: We have already entered supply chain of two of the largest players in that space. And as I'm sure you must have seen in the news over the past few months of the year, the largest OEMs in the aerospace industry, in the aviation industry are looking at India very seriously.

items.statement: Exceptional item INR64.1m from increased employee benefit obligations due to labour law change
items.quote: Adjusted PAT, which is excluding the exceptional item expense of INR64.1 million, related to increase in employee benefit obligations resulting from the change in the labour law by Government of India.

items.statement: Merger subject to regulatory (NCLT, exchanges) and shareholder approvals; timeline 10-12 months
items.quote: this is, of course, subject to a lot of regulatory approvals, because we'll have to get the approval from the exchanges as well as the NCL T for the merger to be finalized. And I think the timeline that we've indicated in our presentation is anywhere between 10 to 12 months

items.statement: Setting up aerospace/defense manufacturing facilities in India currently in works
items.quote: We want to fundamentally set up manufacturing facilities in India for the aerospace and defense vertical, which is currently in the works.

items.statement: Targets 26-30% EBITDA margin in next couple of years
items.quote: With respect to us internally what we're looking at, from an EBITDA perspective, we believe we can be between say 26% to 29% or maybe 30% kind of EBITDA. That is the number that I would look to get to in the next couple of years.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expanded to 22.6% for nine months FY26 from 21.13% last year
items.quote: The EBITDA margin too has been expanding. So it expanded to 22.6% from 21.13% last year.

items.statement: FY26 EBITDA margin expected to remain similar to current levels with only one quarter left
items.quote: See in FY'26 there is only one quarter left so there may not be a dramatic improvement in EBITDA margin so you should look at something similar only.

items.statement: Growth momentum continuing with more customers bidding and winning, existing customers taking more services
items.quote: We expect our momentum to continue because we have been bidding and winning more customers. Our existing customers are taking more services and products from us.

items.statement: Added 5-6 telecom networks annually on average, now at 46 networks across 35 countries
items.quote: As you can see, every year we've been adding 5 to 6 on an average, 5 to 6 customers. Sometimes it's more, sometimes it's a little less, but that's the average. And in the past six years, we have gone up quite significantly from 13 networks to 46 networks.

items.statement: 65-66% of customers now use managed services, up from 1 of 13 in 2019
items.quote: Today about 60% or a little more than 60% of our customers actually, I mean almost like 65% to 66% of our customers actually take services from us as well.

items.statement: Nine-month revenue grew 62% YoY to INR99.12 crores, Q3 revenue grew 69% YoY to INR38.38 crores
items.quote: For the nine-month period ended 31st December, the revenue grew 62% year-on-year to INR99.12 crores

items.statement: Q3 EBITDA grew 119% YoY to INR8.57 crores, nine-month EBITDA grew 73% YoY to INR22.38 crores
items.quote: Coming to the quarter, so Q3 FY '26 performance, revenue grew by 69% year-on-year to INR38.38 crores, while EBITDA grew by 119% year-on-year to INR8.57 crores.

items.statement: Recurring plus re-occurring revenue at 77% for nine months, one-time revenue at 23% due to large perpetual license deals
items.quote: So in this particular quarter, sorry when we look at the nine months now, you will see as compared to the earlier year including this particular quarter, we had 57% of recurring revenue, 20% of re-occurring revenue. That is 77% of recurring plus re-occurring.

items.statement: Organic revenue growth split approximately 60% from existing customers, 40% from new customers
items.quote: From an organic standpoint I would say about 60% to 65% maybe about 60% of the growth is actually from existing customers and the and the rest would come from new customers.

items.statement: R&D expenses fully written off, not capitalized, already factored into margin targets
items.quote: Research and development we are anyway writing off, right? I mean we are not capitalizing. So that's already being written off at this point in time.

items.statement: High barriers to entry due to long sales cycles, reference requirements, proven scale, and patented technology creating significant moat
items.quote: It's a long sales cycle, they have to have references, they have to prove a variety of things, they have to have a track record, and then maybe they can come in and compete with us. So it's a high barrier for entry, there's a large moat.

items.statement: AI viewed as opportunity not threat; launching new AI platform at Mobile World Congress in first week of March
items.quote: We are actually about to launch a very strong AI module or platform, whatever you want to call it, in the next one month which is a collection of all the capabilities that we have launched till now onto a platform and then we are branding that particular platform. You will hear about it in the first week of March.

items.statement: AI will not squeeze margins as business is revenue growth play for customers, not cost reduction
items.quote: Ours is not a cost reduction play for our customers. It is revenue growth play. So when it's revenue growth, I believe, AI will not lead to a reduction in margin or a cost.

items.statement: All customers to date have renewed contracts; high stickiness due to deep integration within telco operations
items.quote: of ours till date has renewed contracts. So we absolutely expect contract renewal to be a regular phenomenon and we don't think these customers will move away that easily because it is actually not easy also for them to move away given the kind of depth that we go to within a Telco

items.statement: Acquisition strategy opportunistic with no fixed timeline; requires product/customer/geography synergy, telecom focus, and ROCE-accretive valuation
items.quote: We just keep looking if we find something which we can acquire, we would like to acquire and if all the contours are in line with what we want then we'll acquire. So it may so happen nothing may happen in the next few years also and something may happen in the next five months also.

items.statement: Learned from Subex experience; will avoid costly debt-funded acquisitions, focus on ROCE protection and financial structure discipline
items.quote: I said we will be focused on ROCE. So that will naturally ensure that we won't go for a costly acquisition because when it's a costly acquisition, your ROCE will go for a toss. Therein lies the answer.

items.statement: Next generation (sons) are shareholders but not on board or active in business; succession planning will happen at right time
items.quote: The next generation is not on the Board, I think you've got that wrong. They are, when you say next generation, actually my two sons, they are not on the Board but they are shareholders at this point in time. They are not active in the business.

items.statement: FY27 tax rate expected similar to FY26, varying slightly based on entity profit contribution mix
items.quote: No, it wouldn't vary too much, but there is one thing that we need to be mindful. It all depends on the revenue contribution between the various entities.

items.statement: Platform handles 1.5 billion subscribers across 46 telecom networks in 35 countries with 11 patents
items.quote: Currently, we are now at 46 telecom networks in about 35 countries. And we are collectively handling about 1.5 billion subscribers on our platform.

items.statement: Largest CVM customer has 250M subscribers, largest Estel customer has ~500M subscribers demonstrating proven scale
items.quote: Our largest customer on the CVM side has about 250 million subscribers on their network. Our largest customer on the Estel division has almost 500 million subscribers.

items.statement: Already surpassed full year FY25 revenue and PAT in first nine months of FY26
items.quote: I also wanted to highlight that we have already surpassed full year FY '25 numbers on both revenue as well as PAT front, which clearly demonstrates a very strong momentum in the business.

items.statement: No specific revenue growth guidance given for next 4-5 years; management prefers investors to derive conclusions from historical track record
items.quote: I mean that will become a projection, so I don't want to give a number or anything. We will have a healthy growth and a healthy margin is all I can say. You should look at the historical track record over the couple of last years how things have been progressing and derive your own conclusion.

name: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited

items.statement: Q4 EBITDA margin guidance of 4%
items.quote: Looking ahead, our focus for quarter 4 will be on sustaining healthy double -digit revenue growth, while expanding EBITDA margins further to our stated guidance of 4%.

items.statement: Foundit break-even expected in next three quarters
items.quote: We are extremely confident that there will be an upward revenue trajectory starting with this current quarter onwards. And in the run up to this, we've also been bringing down our cost base to levels that we have visibility of break-even in next three quarters.

items.statement: Foundit revenue expected to return to INR 25+ crore per quarter
items.quote: We are confident that this should now help us go back to the regular revenue trajectory of around INR 25 plus crores a quarter which we used to see in foundit earlier.

items.statement: Net debt target sub-INR 100 crore by March end
items.quote: We have also called out in our previous calls that this is a company that we will not hesitate in terms of growing inorganically as well. So the priority of buyback as of now is not there while we will have a priority of growing this business organically a nd inorganically which requires capital

items.statement: Telecom rollouts delayed, expected pickup in Q4
items.quote: We expect telecom rollouts to pick up in Q4, driving high single-digit Quarter-on-quarter revenue growth.

items.statement: Security services added 2,500+ headcount in 9M FY26
items.quote: In nine months, we have mobilized close to around 2,500 plus headcounts.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin 3.8% in Q3, up 37 bps QoQ
items.quote: EBITDA margins have improved by 37 basis points over the last quarter to 3.8% in line with our margin guidance as given in the previous quarters.

items.statement: Facility & Food EBITDA margin 4.5%, up 50 bps QoQ
items.quote: EBITDA for this segment stands at 4.5% , a 50 basis points jump from the previous quarter.

items.statement: Telecom & Industrial EBITDA margin 9.9%, up 160 bps QoQ
items.quote: EBITDA for this vertical stands at 9.9% for the quarter a 160 basis points jump.

items.statement: Security EBITDA muted due to INR 75-80 lakh one-time provision
items.quote: So this INR 75 lakh to 80 lakh of one-time provisioning we have taken on certain receivables which post confirmation from the client we have seen that there are certain leeways and penalties.

items.statement: 9M new contract wins of INR 278 crore ACV across Facility, Food, Industrial
items.quote: In nine months, we have secured new contracts worth ₹278 crore across Facility Maintenance, Food, and Industrial verticals.

items.statement: Q3 new contract wins of INR 89 crore ACV across 39 contracts
items.quote: During the quarter, we have mobilized close to around 39 new contracts contributing to an ACV of INR 89 crores.

items.statement: Facility & Food Q3 new wins INR 79 crore ACV
items.quote: New sales continue to be strong in Q3, with business winning contracts worth ₹ 79 crore ACV.

items.statement: Industrial won INR 20 crore ACV contract for consolidated electrical maintenance
items.quote: We won a ₹20 crore ACV contract for consolidated electrical and instrument maintenance for a large manufacturing client. The contract to be mobilized in Q4.

items.statement: New central kitchen in Whitefield expected operational next quarter
items.quote: Commencement of our new central kitchen in Whitefield area remains on track and we expect the same to be operational starting next quarter.

items.statement: Labour Code incremental liability INR 29.8 crore, largely pass-through to clients
items.quote: We have assessed an incremental liability of INR 29.8 crores relating to past service cost in gratuity and leave liabilities. We expect that these costs will largely be passed to the clients over time as we have enough safeguards in our contract terms that allow us to revisit pricing in every event of statutory revisions.

items.statement: Housekeeping new deals at 150-200 bps higher margin vs last year
items.quote: In housekeeping, focus on quality deals have seen the new deals being won at 150 to 200 bps higher margin vs. last year.

items.statement: DSO improved to 98 days from 105 days QoQ
items.quote: Our DSO stands at 98 days as against 105 days reported in the last quarter.

items.statement: Net debt reduced by INR 29 crore QoQ to INR 107 crore
items.quote: As at 31st December, our net debt level is INR 107 crores a reduction of INR 29 crores quarter-on-quarter

items.statement: Interest cost spiked INR 3 crore due to INR 2.2 crore fair value true-up of Vedang put liability
items.quote: Our interest cost has spiked by INR 3 crores of which INR 2.2 crores was due to true up of fair valuation of put liability of an acquisition of Vedang's remaining 1% equity.

items.statement: Foundit funded by 2022 fundraise and INR 50 crore debt at Foundit level
items.quote: We had done a fundraise for foundit back in 2022 and we had also taken borrowings at foundit level to the extent of close to around INR 50-odd crores.

items.statement: Increased stake in Vedang by 2% to ~99%; Terrier 75% held, 25% employee trust
items.quote: The stake sale actually stake purchase rather was in Vedang wherein we were already holding close to around 97% of the company and we increased our stake by further 2 percentage points. As far as Terrier is concerned, 25% of the company is with the employee trust and the balance 75% is with Bluspring.

items.statement: Four Labour Codes notified Nov 21; national floor wage pending
items.quote: On this Labour code, it was a notification given by Government of India on 21st November. Certain clarifications on other aspects of national floor wages is still not announced, but there are many laws that is already effective immediately.

items.statement: Foundit sales productivity up 45% Q3 over Q1
items.quote: Our AI-powered job search platform delivered a revenue of ₹18 crore in Q3, with 45% sales productivity increase Q3 over Q1.

items.statement: Labour Code past service cost INR 29.8 crore recognized as exceptional item; INR 9 crore core employee portion not recoverable
items.quote: This INR 29.8 crores that you can see has two splits in this. One is the core employees of 1,400 people that we are having. That is not passable back to the customer. That amount is close to around INR 9 crores.

items.statement: FY26 revenue expected around INR170-180 crores
items.quote: I made a commitment to everyone that this year I will take a top line of INR160 crores. So, I think this time we will likely lie around INR170 crores-INR180 crores

items.statement: Insurance distribution to start from April
items.quote: It was supposed to be done by this month, but it will start from April onwards.

items.statement: Akiko Pay targeting 1 million customers in six months
items.quote: Then I can see 1 million customers in six months after all integrations are done.

items.statement: Akiko Pay targeting 50 million customer base within 3 years with INR50 crores PAT
items.quote: Opportunity for next 2, 3 years the opportunity size -- within 3 years of 50 million customer base. Opportunity size I see over here of 15 million of PAT.

items.statement: Credit card market growing 15% YoY, loan book market growing 18% for last 5 years
items.quote: So if you see, the credit card market is rising at 15% year-on-year and the loan book market has been rising at around 18% for the last five years.

items.statement: EBITDA margin 16% and PAT margin 11.3% in Q3, expected to sustain and gradually improve
items.quote: Yes, sir. Look, I have realized and understood that operating leverage has indeed improved and there has been significant cost discipline. So going forward, margins should remain stable and gradually improve, I hope.

items.statement: Revenue mix: 30% credit cards, 70% loans (10% secured, 90% unsecured)
items.quote: Sir, this time 30% of our distribution is from credit cards and 70% is from the loans business. Loans include business loans, personal loans, mortg ages, and home loans. If we split secured and unsecured, 10% is secured and 90% is unsecured

items.statement: Monthly credit card volume at 16,000 cards
items.quote: At 16,000 cards on a month-on-month basis.

items.statement: Akiko Pay built by existing IT team, only INR10-15 lakh spent on licenses
items.quote: Sir, there hasn't been any specific total cost for building Akiko Pay; what happened is that the IT team which was already being paid salaries month on month built it, so no extra cost was incurred. Initially, some money was spent on licenses, about INR10-INR15 lakh, otherwise nothing else was spent

items.statement: Credit cost at 0.29% for Q3 FY26

items.quote: What we are seeking is that we were hoping to have a double-digit growth in Xpress credit. There seems to be some movement towards gold loan, may not be significant.

items.statement: Capital adequacy ratio improved 101 bps YoY to 14.04%
items.quote: The bank remains well capitalised, and the capital adequacy ratio has improved by 101 basis points year-on-year and stands at 14.04%.

items.statement: ROE at 20.68% at end of Q3 FY26

items.quote: We had the highest ever orders at about INR14,115 crores, which was 8% growth. But if you look into CAGR growth from 2021 onwards, it has been 16%.

items.quote: Our backlog is at the strongest at INR10,471 crores, which has grown by 12%. And if you look into CAGR for last 5 years, it's 21%.

items.quote: So I think we will have to make sure that our target is always to have double-digit growth on the revenues as well.

items.statement: PAT margin corridor of 12-15% sustainable
items.quote: So, having said that, I think a trajectory at the PAT level, we're talking of between 12% to 15%, still holds good, right?

items.statement: Material cost increased to 61% from 58% due to imported material for QCO, forex, copper prices and order mix
items.quote: Profitability, we are higher on the material cost at this point of time. We are 61% compared to 58% levels what we were earlier. So I think broadly the reasons are, – first of all, we consciously took a decision in the beginning of this year to use imported material to address the QCO concerns, and it was a strategic decision.

items.statement: Full year CY2025 PBT margin 16.9%, ~17.5% excluding Labour Code impact
items.quote: So today, 2025, we closed at 16.9%, give and take another 0.5 % for the Labour Code impact. So, we're talking of 17.5%.

items.statement: Core industries (52% of volumes) showing green shoots in metals, chemicals, oil & gas
items.quote: And core industries, which were kind of, I would say, muted in past, but that forms about 52% of our volumes. We are seeing good green shoots and good signs there. There is a good mix of orders coming from the core industry, especially metals as well as in the chemical, oil and gas and other market segment in the core segment.

items.statement: Data center demand very strong from hyperscalers, Indian conglomerates and co-location providers
items.quote: And we see a very strong demand coming from the data center. And there are not only the hyperscale supporting of the data centers, but there are a lot of big Indian houses, they also have a very big plan to put up the data centers in India.

items.statement: Data center orders ~10-11% of INR 10,471 crore backlog
items.quote: I think in the backlog, which we have of INR 10,471 crores, I think roughly 10%, 11% would be data center orders.

items.statement: QCO implementation continues with extended timelines for phase 2 testing; not rolled back
items.quote: There is nothing called the rollback of the QCO. Just to make it a bit understandable. It's actually the timelines which have been enhanced for testing. So that's the crux of the story, where the government has very clearly indicated that QCO for sure is going to be implemented, no doubt in that.

items.quote: See, in 2025, we took a strategic decision, as what I mentioned, to stock our material to cater to our customers with it from imports, right? items.statement: Exports 10% of revenue, imports ~20% of COGS mainly from EU; net importer
items.quote: So I think that being the case, if we are 10% on exports in terms of revenues, we are almost 20% is on imports, right? So I think we are still exposed to imports and net importer as such.

items.quote: Products, we are definitely high on the products. And channels to market, OEMs and EPCs and the end users are definitely the core market channels we have.

items.quote: Now one of the important recipe for us to grow is to have a continuous customer engagement with the existing customers and also undiscovered customer, undiscovered geographies. items.quote: Now the personnel expenses include a INR 65 crores impact of Labour Code. items.quote: The final dividend declared and approved by Board is at INR 29.59 per share.
